Definition: from G4314 and a derivative of G2247; to peg to, i.e. spike fast:--nail to.
BiblicalUsage: Proseloo means to nail to something, to spike fast. It appears once, and it is the gospel in one word: Christ blotted out the handwriting of ordinances that was against us, and took it out of the way, nailing it to His cross.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe my debt is not filed away somewhere; it was nailed to the cross with Him, and there it died.
